# E0204: two version files declare the same version

A version has one file, at the top of the lineage's directory or under
`history/`, not both. Two files declaring the same version would be two
schemas for it.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
}
```

`ship/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0204]: history/0.0.thema and 0.0.thema both declare version 0.0
 --> 0.0.thema:1:1
  |
1 | Schema: {
  | ^^^^^^
  |
 ::: history/0.0.thema:1:1
  |
1 | Schema: {
  | ------ the other is here
  |
  = help: a version has one file, at the top of the lineage's directory or under history/
```
